name: passenger_car_225_45r17
source: Plausible Magic Formula (MF5.2) coefficient magnitudes for a mid-size performance passenger tyre, following the coefficient naming and equation structure of Pacejka, 'Tyre and Vehicle Dynamics', 3rd ed. (Butterworth-Heinemann, 2012), ch. 4. NOT a measured/proprietary .tir for a specific commercial tyre - PLAN.md P3 explicitly allows 'published or plausible' data with the source noted. Peak friction coefficients (Dx1/Dy1 ~= 1.0-1.05) and cornering/longitudinal stiffness magnitudes (Kx/Ky ~= 16-18x Fz) are consistent with the typical ranges Pacejka's own Table 4.2 and Milliken, 'Race Car Vehicle Dynamics' (SAE, 1995) ch. 2 cite for radial passenger/performance tyres. Dimensions (unloaded_radius=0.317 m, width=0.205 m) match a 225/45R17 tyre's nominal geometry and data/models/car_sedan/car_sedan.rig.json's own wheel radius. low_speed_damping_ratio/low_speed_damping_vx (PHYS-033 I1) were chosen by measurement against the standstill-wiggle telemetry (CLAUDE.md's Vehicle system section), not from a published tyre.
